cards.title: Ten enemies
cards.text: One simple shape each. The shape tells you what it does.
cards.why: From your maze doc: most enemies share a shape and differ by behaviour. Mark any that's dull or unfair.

parts.title: Mite
parts.text: Small red circle. Swarms toward you. The fodder.

parts.title: Dart
parts.text: Thin triangle. When it sees you it flashes, then charges in a straight line until a wall. Dash sideways.

parts.title: Brute
parts.text: Big square. Slow and tanky, shoves smaller enemies along, hard to knock back.

parts.title: Spitter
parts.text: Diamond. Keeps its distance, needs line of sight, lobs slow orbs. Break line of sight.

parts.title: Splitter
parts.text: Hexagon. Splits into 2, then 4 small ones. Blasts and Pierce.

parts.title: Bomber
parts.text: Runs at you, swells, blows up. Its blast hurts enemies too: kill it in a crowd.

parts.title: Crawler
parts.text: Half-circle stuck to a wall. Slides along it and fires across the corridor. Bounce and Ghost.

parts.title: Drifter
parts.text: Faded outline that floats through walls slowly. Can only be hit while solid; it flickers in and out.

parts.title: Shield
parts.text: Square with a front bar that blocks shots. Turns slowly. Go around: Bounce, Home, Orbit, blasts.

parts.title: Nest
parts.text: Spiky star in a dead end, making Mites. Kill it for a chest.

cards.title: Elites and bosses
cards.text: Elites carry your modules. A boss every 5 minutes.
cards.why: Elites tie enemies to the module system: same parts both ways.

parts.title: Elites
parts.text: A normal enemy with a module, shown as a coloured ring. An elite Spitter with Burn throws fire. Killing it drops that module.

parts.title: Hulk, 5:00
parts.text: A square as wide as a corridor that rolls through the maze. You can't get past, so you route around and hit it from behind.

parts.title: Queen, 10:00
parts.text: Sits in a hall spawning waves, behind a ring of shields that open in turn.

parts.title: Mirror, 15:00
parts.text: A copy of you built from your own casts and modules. Your build fights you.

cards.title: Elites drop modules
cards.text: Killing an elite always drops the module it carried?
cards.why: It gives a second way to find modules besides chests, and makes elites worth chasing. The risk: fewer reasons to explore dead ends.
cards.pick: Yes, always, but at common rarity. Chests stay the way to rare ones.

cards.title: The Mirror boss
cards.text: A boss built from your own build?
cards.why: It's the strongest proof the system is generic: the same modules run on an enemy. The risk is a build that's unbeatable against itself, like heavy Ghost or Leech.
cards.pick: Yes, at 15:00, with half your levels.
